name: cn.dianyinhuoban.szg.mvp.machine.view.MachineTransferActivity
description: The Dianyinhuoban SHENGZHANGUI (DY_SZG) business SDK opens the machine-transfer section from machine management. It shows machine counts and team machine records, supports refresh, and links to transfer and transfer-history pages.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes machine transfers and their history entry.
